reborn-1457.rationale: Poison Draw Frog has a real TCG-vs-OCG rules divergence. Current official TCG English text explicitly excludes the case where the card was attacked while face-down and destroyed by battle. Official Japanese OCG Neuron Q&A explicitly allows that exact case because the monster flips face-up before battle destruction. The pinned Project Ignis implementation follows the OCG-style previous-face-up rule and therefore does not implement the Reborn format's current TCG authority. The reviewed Reborn override records whether this exact Frog was face-down when it became an attack target and suppresses the GY draw only if that state is still present and the actual send-to-GY reason is battle. A later face-up attack clears the flag, while non-battle sends remain eligible even after a canceled earlier attack. The flag intentionally survives the battle flip and move to the GY so EVENT_TO_GRAVE can enforce the TCG exception. This review certifies only the exact corrected executable script.

note: Script-hash-bound TCG-specific implementation review for Poison Draw Frog's face-down-when-attacked battle exception.
